content.body: emilio jarhar Luke Warlow: so in the HTML standard we have statements like "The following styles are expected to apply to select elements when they are being rendered with base appearance:" But then the style sheet that follows impacts much more than just `select` elements. WebKit currently follows Chromium with using some kind of function, but it seems to me that is not enough for `option` elements. Or do you also have some kind of inheritance bit so that `option` elements know whether the `select` element has it? I guess that could work...
